tasks.task: Run the weekly check and write the results note

items.when: Before account decisions: establish scope, evidence, execution access and verification
Once a week, same day, to work through the account in a fixed order
When you have fresh exports and need a short note the owner can act on
When you want waste cut, a scale-or-hold call and a change list to approve each week
When you have one export and a target, to see which changes are worth making

tasks.task: Review search terms and build the negatives list

items.when: When you need three lists to approve: keywords to add, negatives to add, terms to watch
Weekly or fortnightly, with a search terms export, for a quick review
When you want a second sort with where each term goes and a waste score
When waste is large, to get negatives by level and the pattern behind them
When winning searches deserve their own ad groups and pages

tasks.task: Audit a Google Ads account

items.when: When you take over an account and need a senior buyer's audit
When you have the exports, for a second audit of tracking, terms, Shopping and bids
When it is a store, to find brand leakage and get a 90-day fix order
When brand searches flatter the results, to find the true non-brand return
When you need wasted spend and standout campaigns named from the exports
When the client also runs Microsoft Ads imported from Google

tasks.task: Check and fix conversion tracking

items.when: Before any optimising, to check Google counts the right conversions once, with values
When you have the conversion actions, for a pass or fail on double counting
When tracking needs a plan across analytics and ad platforms with a test for each event
When the store is on Shopify and needs purchase tracking and enhanced conversions built
When Google Ads, analytics and the store report different conversions
When tracking should be re-checked every month for breaks and double counts

tasks.task: Set up call and form tracking for local leads

items.when: When calls and forms are the conversions and you must check each is counted once
When calls or forms are not tracked, to set up or repair what counts as a lead
When you have a lead export, to link each lead to the campaign and ad behind it
When leads are cheap but poor, to work out cost per qualified lead

tasks.task: Take in a new client and set break-even targets

items.when: In the first conversation with a new client, before touching the account
When you have price and margin, to set break-even return and cost per sale
When the margin is a guess, to work out profit per order from every cost
When targets are vague, to track cost per customer and test small before scaling

tasks.task: Plan and launch a search campaign

items.when: When a new account, campaign type or market needs the launch checklist
Before building, to get the fewest campaigns that work, each with a reason
When you need keywords sorted by intent and grouped into themes
When you have products and search terms and need ad groups, keywords and ads
When buyers search the problem, not the product, to try a problem-led campaign
When the brand name needs its own Search and Shopping campaigns kept apart
When the plan is drafted, for a second view on structure, bids and budget split

tasks.task: Build a local search campaign for a service firm

items.when: When each service and area needs its own ad group, keywords and ads
When the firm pays for calls about jobs it does not do and needs a negatives list
When each service and area needs search ad text
When the business listing is weak and holds back local and call results
Before launch, to confirm the booking or call page works and the service is offered in the target area

tasks.task: Write responsive search ads

items.when: When an ad group is new, Ad Strength is poor or a fresh angle needs testing
When you want twenty or more headlines sorted by type to pick from
When each headline must fit the character limit, with one to test first
When every line must rest on a real fact with its source
When the ads are written, to score how well they match the landing page
Before upload, to flag policy risks line by line with safer rewrites
Before the ads are written, to confirm the landing page loads and shows the price and offer the ads name

tasks.task: Choose and set the bid strategy

items.when: When each campaign needs the right strategy for its volume, values and budget
When you have results and targets, to confirm the strategy and check for a ROAS spiral
When the client asks to raise spend, to find the real return first

tasks.task: Set budgets and pacing across campaigns

items.when: When you want three budget plans compared before changing anything
When a sale is coming, for a pacing sheet with scale, hold and cut rules
When budget moves between Meta and Google, to compare on matched dates and sales
When the budget change needs the client's yes before it goes live

tasks.task: Structure Shopping campaigns by margin

items.when: When you have margin and return by product, to tier them with a target each
When best sellers should have their own campaign and brand negatives
When you want a guided run from tiers to weekly tuning and title fixes
Before the new structure goes live, to run the launch checklist
Before budget goes to a product group, to confirm its products are in stock at the feed price

tasks.task: Build Performance Max campaigns and asset groups

items.when: When you have catalogue, budget and break-even numbers, for a fit verdict and a build
When a feed-only version might waste less, to compare it with a full build
When you want a guided launch with rules for when to scale
When asset groups need headlines and descriptions for each category
Before the asset groups go live, to confirm the products and landing pages they point to work today

tasks.task: Review Performance Max each month

items.when: Monthly, or when a campaign takes budget without clear results
When you have the exports, for this week's checks, exclusions and a budget move
When Performance Max may be taking credit for brand searches

tasks.task: Review product performance and cut budget eaters

items.when: When you have a weekly Shopping export, to see which products to cut, fix or fund
When stock days and costs matter, to grade each product and set its ad target
When exclusions and budget moves need the client's approval

tasks.task: Fix Merchant Center diagnostics and feed titles

items.when: When you have the diagnostics, to rank problems by lost sales
When a suspension is possible, to rank each gap by risk
When titles miss what people search, to rewrite titles and descriptions

tasks.task: Check the landing page behind the ads

items.when: When click costs are high or leads are poor, to score the match between ad and page
When the page gets clicks but few leads, to rank the conversion problems

tasks.task: Run the monthly account review and report

items.when: Once a month, and after any big change to the site, tracking or platform
When you want results reviewed against targets with ranked findings
When the owner needs a report with trends, wins, misses and next steps
When the review is for a lead business, to report cost per qualified lead

tasks.task: Find why results dropped

items.when: When results fell, to weigh recent changes and get a fix-or-wait call
When the cause is unclear, to test six possible causes against local baselines
Before blaming the ads, to rule out a tracking break

tasks.task: Write change requests for client approval

items.when: Whenever a change to the live account needs the client's yes
Before asking to raise spend, to see whether the account passes five gates

tasks.task: Add remarketing, Demand Gen and YouTube

items.when: When you have site traffic and a customer list, to plan lists and exclusions
When past visitors need their own campaigns with budgets and caps
When video winners exist and Demand Gen should reach cold traffic
When you must show whether the new channel pays
When YouTube ads have run, for a scale, keep or pause call per ad

tasks.task: Plan experiments and prove what the ads add

items.when: When the client doubts the ads add sales, to size a lift test by region
When one campaign type is in doubt, to hold it back and compare
When an ad or page test has run, to check the split and say if the result is real
When every sale is credited to the last click, to ask what the ads really caused

tasks.task: Read competitors' ads and search share

items.when: When you need rivals' public ads and pages set out, with proof kept apart from guesses
When you want a monthly tracker of brand searches against rivals

always.when: For every Google task: verify account scope, tools, attribution and delivery before diagnosis or changes
Before you quote a number, when Google Ads and the store or analytics disagree
Before a note or report goes to the owner, to put account terms into plain words

helpers.when: When the ads are sound and the landing page is what loses the lead or sale
When feed, tags or checkout tracking must be changed inside the store
When the question is credit across channels, not inside Google Ads
When cross-channel allocation needs Jared; keep Google execution and account authority with the Google buyer
When a local firm needs its listing, reviews and local pages fixed first
When Performance Max, Demand Gen or YouTube need images and video made

gaps: No library item sets up Local Services Ads or writes lead dispute notes
No library item writes call ads or plans call tracking: numbers, call length rules and recordings
No library item writes Performance Max asset groups: headlines, images, video and audience signals per category
No library item writes responsive search ads with pins and Ad Strength in mind; only the kit prompt does
No library item plans location targeting, radius and bid changes by area for a local firm
No library item imports offline sales or lead quality back into Google Ads
No library item writes a change request for approval or keeps a change log; only the kit prompt does
No library item checks consent mode and how consent choices change what Google Ads counts
No library item reads auction insights or plans sitelinks, callouts and other ad assets
No tool guides exist for Google Ads, Merchant Center, Tag Manager or call tracking tools
